assumptions.arrivals: Replay Saturday 12:07 onward, one record per observed group; fixed arrivals in every replication. Horizon is a new 60-minute experimental window, not a confirmed original closing time.
assumptions.initial_state: Empty system; pre-existing customers and occupied seats are unknown. No warm-up deletion for this finite trace experiment.
assumptions.groups: One order per group, one kiosk per order, atomic seats for the whole group, one sampled dining duration shared by that group. Missing group size explicitly imputed as 1.
assumptions.ordering: A recorded machine use forces kiosk use. For unrecorded cases, 16/66 is a provisional probability based on historical order-prefix interpretation; not confirmed phone/kiosk ground truth.
assumptions.dining: Use observed selection flag when present; otherwise use 47/80 from historical notebook. Flag is interpreted as intended dining, not guaranteed realized dining.
assumptions.food_delay: Order-to-completion duration is a proxy for remaining food delay after ordering (or on arrival for non-kiosk parties and couriers). It includes historical congestion; no additional kitchen queue is added. Preordering remaining times cannot be calibrated.
assumptions.resources: FIFO kiosks; strict FIFO group seat queue after food ready, no pre-reservation. No abandonment unless patience explicitly set. Kitchen/courier pickup counters are not capacity modeled.
assumptions.uncertainty: Intervals describe Monte Carlo variability conditional on this trace, empirical samples and assumptions; no input uncertainty or external validation.
assumptions.relationship: New Python reference model; not an execution-equivalent translation of the historical ALP. Differences must remain explicit.

interval_scope: Student-t Monte Carlo intervals across replications; paired scenario differences use the same seed and per-group uniforms. Input uncertainty excluded.
termination: Arrivals in [0,H); track occupancy only up to H; drain all accepted parties after H.
tie_order: Resource completions and food readiness, then seat timeouts, then arrivals; insertion order breaks ties within a priority.
model: New Python reference; not equivalent to historical ALP.
